title: Real-process harness and seeded fault proxy for the slice suites
objective: Acceptance suites can spawn the five slice binaries — qip-fabricd, qip-ledgerd, qip-edge-node, qip-api and qip-cli's `qip` — on free ports, refuse a missing or stale binary naming the build command, parse their bound addresses, scrape /metrics, place a seeded stall/blackhole/drop-acks/cut proxy between processes, and never leak a child.
why: ADR 0100 §8's eight tests spawn real processes. A missing binary must fail naming the build command (never skip), and every wait must be a bounded poll on an observable condition so the suites are not flaky under ADR 0098's worker ceiling (red-team m10). Red-team major: cargo builds no sibling crate's binary for qip-acceptance's integration tests, so a present but stale binary let an e2e mutation run against old code in either direction; and the suites need a fifth binary, `qip`, for the grant and `qip event-fabric verify`. The wave finding: the old dependency on the scaffold was spurious (tests/support/*.rs is a module, not an auto-discovered target, and no dev-dependency is added), so this packet runs in wave 1.
constraints: Binaries resolved from std::env::current_exe()'s target/<profile>/ directory: qip-fabricd, qip-ledgerd, qip-edge-node, qip-api and qip. Absent -> panic naming `cd backend && cargo build -p qip-fabricd -p qip-ledgerd -p qip-edge-node -p qip-api -p qip-cli --bins`. Stale -> the same panic: a binary whose mtime is older than the newest .rs or Cargo.toml under its package's directory or under any in-workspace path dependency's directory, found through `cargo metadata --format-version 1` (the precedent in api_boundary.rs), is refused, never run.
Ports are :0; addresses parsed from each process's 'listening on' / 'health on' line.
Children are SIGKILLed on Drop, including on panic; stdout/stderr captured to files printed on failure.
Fault schedules come from a seed (Xoshiro256); same seed, same schedule.
No sleep used as a wait; every wait is a bounded poll with a named deadline.
Thresholds (seal age, pressure ratios, intervals) are passed as configuration so suites run in seconds (m10).

objective: One pure byte format serves the spool, the wire and broker segments: batches round-trip byte for byte, every CONTRACT-048 field is carried, each header field is set by exactly the stage (writer, drain or broker) the codec's table names, and decode has exactly three outcomes (complete, torn tail, corrupt).
